本模型依据现存东大殿的测绘与研究，以规则化构件表达结构。柱网与铺作类型有文献依据: This model represents the existing East Hall through regularized components based on measured surveys and research. The column layout and bracket-set types are documented; concealed joints, some dimensions, roof layouts and surface details include identified inferences. Component counts refer to generated model parts. A complete inventory of every surviving physical component has not been obtained.
拖动旋转、滚轮缩放、右键平移。Shift＋左键拖动可绕按下位置的模型表面旋转，松: Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, and right-drag to pan. Shift-left-drag orbits around the model surface under the pointer when the drag begins; the pivot remains after release. Resetting the view or changing studies restores the default pivot. This gesture controls only the camera during assembly as well. Select a component to read its notes. Use the left panel to hide layers or explore a bracket set, and the Exploded View slider to separate components. Shortcuts: F to focus, H to hide the selected component, and Esc to return to the whole hall.
先进入感兴趣的组件，再选择“引导拼装”。旋转待安装构件、拖动构件或使用插入滑块，: Open an assembly, then choose Guided Assembly. Rotate the active component, then drag it or use the insertion slider to approach its target along the indicated direction. Press R to rotate, the arrow keys to adjust insertion, and Enter to check placement. Hints can be turned off.
